issues.description: Re-ingesting into an existing database does not delete stale rows from results, so removed input records remain in reports.
Rows with empty run_id/model/task are accepted, causing silent overwrites and unusable canonical data.
Valid JSONL lines that are not objects, or whose metrics field is not an object, raise AttributeError and abort ingest.
Malformed Harness C XML is not caught, so one bad XML file crashes the entire ingest instead of recording a warning.
Non-finite scores such as NaN are not rejected or clamped and can crash insertion with a database integrity error.
Fixture generation recursively deletes the user-supplied directory without guardrails, making accidental destructive use easy.
Harness A CSV headers are ignored, so reordered or incorrect columns are silently misparsed.
Reporting on a mistyped or missing database path silently creates an empty SQLite database instead of failing clearly.
Tests cover generated fixture behavior but miss malformed JSON/XML, non-finite scores, empty identifiers, and changed-input reingest cases.
